entry.author: NMITNZ
entry.summary:
Discover how the Kaitiaki Training Ranger programme empowers students with hands-on skills and confidence in river crossing, helicopter safety, and four-wheel drive training in this elective. Join Fay McKenzie as she shares how practical experience builds confidence and prepares future conservation professionals for real-world challenges.

Tutors: Fay McKenzie, Geoff Button, external helicopter providers

Get ready for an immersive experience in the field! This course equips you with essential skills for working safely and effectively in remote conservation environments. You’ll learn how to:
• Safely operate around helicopters
• Drive a 4WD vehicle on rugged terrain
• Read and cross rivers confidently, both solo and in groups

With a mix of theory and hands-on training, including online modules and supervised practical sessions, this course prepares you for the realities of conservation work in Aotearoa’s wild landscapes.

Please note that a Learner driver's licence is needed, and at least a restricted licence is expected. Practical experience driving a manual vehicle is also required.

Join Fay McKenzie and the team to gain practical skills in river crossing, helicopter safety, and four-wheel drive training, all essential for remote conservation work. This course blends theory and hands-on sessions, building your confidence for field challenges. A minimum of a restricted license and manual driving experience is required.
